core_result: Resolves two open structural questions of Vinciguerra (arXiv:2609.18692): (1) proves the complete base-p digit-sum dichotomy for two-register passive catalytic programs over every prime field F_p (f in RP^{pass}_{F_p}(2,t) iff s_p(d) <= min(p-1, t-1) for all d >= 2 with alpha_d != 0), collapsing characteristic-0 lower bounds via x^{p^m} in 2 accesses while proving permanent impossibility whenever s_p(d) >= p (e.g., x^3 over F_2), plus sharp F_4 separation (t_min(5)=3, t_min(3)=4, x^7 impossible) and literal commutative-ring/F_4-algebra soundness bridges; (2) proves strictly bilinear 2-access Frobenius collapse x^{2^k} over any char-2 commutative ring in k+1 registers (4k-2 ops, and k+2 registers with strictly distinct operands); (3) breaks Vinciguerra's 3-register exponent log_5 4 ~ 0.861353 down to the unique global integer minimizer log_13 8 ~ 0.810714 (certified via explicit Pascal-row shear loops for x^7..x^15 and universal Nat optimality forall t >= 4, t != 8), formalizing complete 4-register passive powering for all N >= 1 (T3h) and algebraic product-ring streaming frequency moments F_D (T3i) in Lean 4.35, while quadratic-shear prog5_x7 sharpens non-commutative matrix powering to O(N^{log_7 5}) with zero extra scalar registers; and (4) proves a balanced zero-workspace bilinear multilinear product x_0...x_{d-1} in log_2 d + 2 registers and (7d^2-4)/3 ops. Accompanied by 8/8 strict monotonic-ID verified CaDiCaL 2.1.2 LRAT UNSAT certificates (18,932 steps) contrasting Boolean XAG rigidity, 22/22 pytest suites, 100.0% Build Standard v1.1.0 compliance (62/62), live GitHub Pages SVG Blueprint, DigiCert RFC 3161 TSA, OpenTimestamps, and Sigstore SLSA attestations.
